name: Auction Poker
description: Auction Poker is a dynamic Stud variant where the primary mechanic is 'buying' improved position or cards from a communal marketplace. Unlike standard poker where you are dealt what you get, Auction Poker allows players to actively purchase cards from a face-up display or the top of the deck, paying a premium to the pot to refine their hand before betting rounds.

content.text: Auction Poker is a dynamic Stud variant where the primary mechanic is 'buying' improved position or cards from a communal marketplace. Unlike standard poker where you are dealt what you get, Auction Poker allows players to actively purchase cards from a face-up display or the top of the deck, paying a premium to the pot to refine their hand before betting rounds.

Emerging from the 'Dealer's Choice' tradition in American home games, Auction Poker (and its sibling 'Buy Your Card') was designed to increase pot sizes and reduce the impact of purely random distribution.
2-6 players (to ensure enough cards in the deck for buying rounds).
Initial: 2 cards face down, 3 cards face up to each player. Market: 3 cards dealt face up in a row in the center.

items.text: Auction Flop: Players bid against each other for the right to take cards from a community flop.
Market Wilds: If a Joker appears in the market, its price is doubled, but it acts as a wild card.
